scope: Authored visual asset types in the core src/ game, including valley, tea-house interior, summit, characters, physical items and visible effects. Assemblies and separately recognizable parts are separate rows; procedural instances are not.
exclusions: HUD, menus, dialogue text, journal-only keepsakes, audio/music, invisible colliders and simulation helpers.
Lab-only proposals and Roof Road (a separate prototype, not loaded by the game).
dawCAT, cadJS, OLD, arbitrary CAD overrides and per-instance procedural placements.
Every individual texture, material, triangle, animation pose and shader helper; these belong to their owning asset types.
claimLimit: The source inventory is manually reviewed, with an automated construction-method ledger and evidence-link checks. It is not a runtime scene census or proof that each mapped specimen renders correctly. Direct means a focused study exists, not that its result has shipped to the game.
